entities.summary: Dorie S. Murrey is an American former professional basketball player. He was a 6-foot-8-inch (2.03 m), 215-pound power forward and he played collegiately at the University of Detroit Mercy. He has played in the National Basketball Association (NBA) from 1966 to 1972. He was originally selected with the second pick in the 2nd round of the 1966 NBA draft by the Detroit Pistons, his hometown team.
